title: V1 shopping-cart MVVM layer validation
user_prompt: Develop a phone shopping-cart page with Model/ViewModel/View/Page layers. Load product data from rawfile JSON, keep the View away from Model data, and provide a complete V1 MVVM implementation plan.
intent: Validate MVVM-01 routing and V1 observation with @Observed, @Track, @ObjectLink, @State, @Builder, and one-way Model to ViewModel to View data flow.

title: V1 music playlist MVVM layer validation
user_prompt: Develop a phone music playlist page with Model/ViewModel/View/Page layers. The View must invoke ViewModel methods indirectly and the solution must target V1 state management.
intent: Validate MVVM-01 routing, precise @Track updates, @ObjectLink item observation, @State page binding, @Builder reuse, and one-way data flow.

title: V2 contacts MVVM layer validation
user_prompt: Develop a phone contacts page with Model/ViewModel/View/Page layers. Use @Param for read-only child data, @Event for actions, Repeat for lists, and V2 state management.

title: V2 weather-city management MVVM layer validation
user_prompt: Develop a phone weather city-management page with Model/ViewModel/View/Page layers. Use @Param, @Event, Repeat, @Computed, @ComponentV2, and @Local.
intent: Validate MVVM-02 routing and V2 property observation, callback data-source updates, list rendering, computed values, and page assembly.
